steps.details: equimolar amounts of transition metal diethyldithiocarbamate precursors dissolved in dichloromethane

evidence.text_snippet: equimolar amounts (0.1 mmol per precursor) of transition metal diethyldithiocarbamate precursors, M(S2CNEt2)x (where M = Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn and x = 2 or 3), were dissolved in a minimum volume of dichloromethane.

steps.details: solvent allowed to evaporate leaving a powder of mixed precursors

evidence.text_snippet: The solvent was allowed to evaporate, leaving a powder of mixed precursors.

steps.details: heated to 900 °C at 15 °C min-1 ramp rate in static air and held for 4 h

evidence.text_snippet: This powder was transferred to a ceramic boat in a hot-walled box furnace and heated to 900°C( 1 5°Cm i n−1 ramp rate) whilst exposed to static air, then held for 4 h unless stated otherwise.
The 7-metal HESO showed a T10 value of 168 °C, which was 63% lower than the 4-metal MESO (at 454°C)
and a T50 value of 250°C, which was 56% lower than the 5-metal HESO (at 569 °C).
The 7-metal HESO showed a T10 value of 168 °C, which was 63% lower than the 4-metal MESO (at 454°C)
and a T50 value of 250°C, which was 56% lower than the 5-metal HESO (at 569 °C).
The activity of commercially sourced Fe3O4 was also evaluated as a comparison and was found to have an intermediate T50 of 371°C.
